A '''steel hoe''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]], made by smithing an [[Iron Hoe|iron hoe]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_hoe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines hoe blocks at speed 8.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 1 damage with an attack speed of 2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 3 (real value 2).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_hoe.json}}</ref>
